summary: clamp(min, preferred, max) picks a size that follows the window width but stays between a minimum and a maximum. It replaces several media queries with one line.
notes: In the preview (about 640px wide), 1rem + 4vw = 16 + 25.6 = 41.6px for the h1. That is between the min (28px) and max (56px), so 41.6px is used.
At 320px wide the formula gives 28.8px. At 1200px it gives 64px, so the max of 3.5rem (56px) is used instead.
Mixing rem and vw in the middle value (1rem + 4vw) keeps text growing when someone zooms in, which vw alone does not do.
pitfall: Using only vw for font size (font-size: 5vw). Text becomes tiny on phones and huge on wide screens, and browser zoom has no effect on it.
